## The problem

What gap in the stress-test does this address? An idea type it handles weakly, a question that doesn't push back hard enough, a missing cheap test?

## Proposed change

What you'd add or change. Be concrete — ideally the exact wording of a question or test.

## Keep the adversarial spirit

How does this help the user **find the truth more cheaply**, rather than make the skill softer or more flattering? (See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../CONTRIBUTING.md).)

## Area

- [ ] More cheap-test patterns (Phase 5)
- [ ] Sharper pushback prompts (which phase?)
- [ ] Domain-specific variant (B2B SaaS / consumer / marketplace / other)
- [ ] Research guidance (Phase 3)
- [ ] Other
